prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a rear-end collision. The patient had 21 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1095; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with pain and swelling of the left wrist. Radiographs confirmed a non-displaced fracture of the distal radius. The wrist was immobilized in a short arm cast, and the patient was counseled on elevation, pain management, and activity restriction.

Over the course of treatment, the patient attended 21 visits for orthopedic follow-up, serial imaging, cast management, and rehabilitation. Healing progressed as expected on follow-up radiographs, and the cast was removed at the appropriate interval. Following cast removal, the patient began a structured hand therapy program focused on restoring range of motion, grip strength, and forearm function. Progress was steady, with gradual improvement in stiffness and strength over subsequent sessions.

At the most recent evaluation, the patient reported mild residual discomfort with heavy lifting but had regained most functional use of the wrist for daily activities. Ongoing home exercises were recommended, and the patient was advised to return for reassessment if symptoms worsen or new limitations develop.
